headline: The biggest reason customers are unhappy is payment and checkout failures, and the fastest extra win is fixing sign-up and login problems.
summary: The top issues are payment and checkout failures, unhelpful customer support, late or slow delivery. The ranking weighs how widespread each issue is, how unhappy those customers are, and how hard it is to fix.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A recent release likely broke the coupon or payment step.
themes.business_impact: Lost orders at the last step and a risk to payment trust.
themes.action: Hotfix the coupon and payment flow and add duplicate-charge protection.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Support is likely understaffed for escalations, with a bot that has no route to a person.
themes.business_impact: Unresolved problems turn a single bad order into a lost customer.
themes.action: Add a human escalation path and a clear refund rule for missing items.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Delivery estimates may be too optimistic, and courier supply may fall short at peak hours.
themes.action: Recalibrate delivery estimates and send live updates when an order runs late.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: One-time passwords may depend on a single SMS provider with delivery gaps.
themes.business_impact: New customers give up before their first order.
themes.action: Add a backup SMS provider and a resend option.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Recent releases may lack testing on older devices.
themes.business_impact: Crashes interrupt ordering and damage ratings.
themes.action: Add crash monitoring and a release check on older devices.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Fees may not be explained clearly, so the app compares badly with rivals.
themes.business_impact: Price-sensitive customers may move to cheaper apps.
themes.action: Test clearer fee breakdowns and a free-delivery threshold.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Variety and ease of use likely keep loyal customers coming back.
themes.business_impact: These strengths support retention while issues are fixed.
themes.action: Protect these strengths and feature them in marketing.

follow_up_question: Should I dig into the reviews behind payment and checkout failures, or turn these actions into a one-page plan?
